description: This Java source file defines the InitializationFilter class, which is part of the OpenMRS web application. It handles the first-time startup initialization process, including database setup, configuration, user creation, and module import during the initial installation wizard. It manages multiple steps of an installation wizard, handles database and environment configuration, and orchestrates tasks like creating databases, users, and updating the database schema.

classes.name: InitializationCompletion
classes.description: A helper inner class that manages the background execution of database setup, user creation, schema updates, and other initialization tasks in a separate thread. Tracks progress, errors, and task execution status during the initial installation process.

classes.name: WizardTask
classes.description: An enumeration of tasks that can be performed during initialization, such as creating schemas, tables, users, importing test data, and updating schemas.
